mapper.select: SELECT LMS_PRF_ID FROM LMS_PROFILE WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.sql: SELECT asn.LEC_ASN_ID AS assignmentId, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS courseName, l.LEC_SECTION AS lecSection, asn.LEC_ASN_TITLE AS title, TO_CHAR(asn.LEC_ASN_DUE_DATE, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS dueDate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION sb WHERE sb.LEC_ASN_ID = asn.LEC_ASN_ID AND sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_STATUS != 'NSB') AS submittedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION sb JOIN ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION_EVALUATION ev ON ev.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID = sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID WHERE sb.LEC_ASN_ID = asn.LEC_ASN_ID AND ev.ASN_SBM_EVL_SCORE IS NOT NULL) AS gradedCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e WHERE e.LEC_ID = asn.LEC_ID AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP') AS totalStudents FROM LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT asn JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = asn.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID JOIN SEMESTERS s ON s.SEM_ID = l.SEM_ID WHERE l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId} AND s.SEM_YEAR = #{year} AND s.SEM_TERM = #{termCode}
mapper.select:
SELECT base.* FROM ( ) base WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY base.dueDate, base.assignmentId OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT base.courseName AS courseName, SUM(GREATEST(base.totalStudents - base.gradedCount, 0)) AS "count" FROM ( ) base GROUP BY base.courseName HAVING SUM(GREATEST(base.totalStudents - base.gradedCount, 0)) > 0 ORDER BY base.courseName

SELECT asn.LEC_ASN_ID AS assignmentId, lc.LEC_COD_NAME AS courseName, asn.LEC_ASN_TITLE AS title, TO_CHAR(asn.LEC_ASN_DUE_DATE, 'YYYY.MM.DD') AS dueDate FROM LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT asn JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = asn.LEC_ID JOIN LECTURE_CODE lc ON lc.LEC_CODE_ID = l.LEC_CODE_ID WHERE asn.LEC_ASN_ID = #{assignmentId} AND l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId}

SELECT sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID AS submissionId, m.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, m.MEMBER_NAME AS studentName, m.LOGIN_ID AS studentNo, TO_CHAR(sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_REG_DATE, 'MM.DD HH24:MI') AS submittedAt, sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_STATUS AS submissionStatus, ev.ASN_SBM_EVL_SCORE AS score, ev.ASN_SBM_EVL_FEEDBACK AS feedback FROM LECTURE_STUDENT_ENROLLMENT e JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = e.LEC_ID JOIN LMS_PROFILE p ON p.LMS_PRF_ID = e.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = p.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION sb ON sb.LEC_ASN_ID = #{assignmentId} AND sb.LMS_PRF_ID = e.LMS_PRF_ID LEFT JOIN ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION_EVALUATION ev ON ev.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID = sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID WHERE e.LEC_ID = (SELECT LEC_ID FROM LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT WHERE LEC_ASN_ID = #{assignmentId}) AND l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId} AND e.LEC_STD_ENR_STATUS != 'DRP' ORDER BY m.MEMBER_NAME, m.MEMBER_ID

SELECT att.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID AS submissionId, att.ASN_SBM_ATT_ORG_FIL_NAME AS fileName, att.ASN_SBM_ATT_FIL_SIZE AS fileSize, att.ASN_SBM_ATT_EXT_TYPE AS contentType, att.ASN_SBM_ATT_TRN_FIL_NAME AS trnFileName, att.ASN_SBM_ATT_ORG_URL AS orgUrl FROM ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION_ATTACHMENT att JOIN LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION sb ON sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID = att.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID WHERE sb.LEC_ASN_ID = #{assignmentId} ORDER BY att.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID, att.ASN_SBM_ATT_REG_DATE DESC

SELECT sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID AS submissionId, m.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, m.MEMBER_NAME AS studentName, m.LOGIN_ID AS studentNo, TO_CHAR(sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_REG_DATE, 'MM.DD HH24:MI') AS submittedAt, sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_STATUS AS submissionStatus, ev.ASN_SBM_EVL_SCORE AS score, ev.ASN_SBM_EVL_FEEDBACK AS feedback FROM LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION sb JOIN LECTURE_ASSIGNMENT asn ON asn.LEC_ASN_ID = sb.LEC_ASN_ID JOIN LECTURE l ON l.LEC_ID = asn.LEC_ID JOIN LMS_PROFILE p ON p.LMS_PRF_ID = sb.LMS_PRF_ID JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_ID = p.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION_EVALUATION ev ON ev.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID = sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID WHERE sb.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID = #{submissionId} AND l.LMS_PRF_ID = #{professorLmsPrfId}

SELECT att.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID AS submissionId, att.ASN_SBM_ATT_ORG_FIL_NAME AS fileName, att.ASN_SBM_ATT_FIL_SIZE AS fileSize, att.ASN_SBM_ATT_EXT_TYPE AS contentType, att.ASN_SBM_ATT_TRN_FIL_NAME AS trnFileName, att.ASN_SBM_ATT_ORG_URL AS orgUrl FROM ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION_ATTACHMENT att WHERE att.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID = #{submissionId} ORDER BY att.ASN_SBM_ATT_REG_DATE DESC
mapper.update: MERGE INTO ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION_EVALUATION ev USING (SELECT #{submissionId} AS sbmId FROM dual) src ON (ev.LEC_ASN_SBM_ID = src.sbmId) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET ev.ASN_SBM_EVL_SCORE = #{score}, ev.ASN_SBM_EVL_FEEDBACK = #{feedback}, ev.ASN_SBM_EVL_REG_DATE = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ASN_SBM_EVL_ID, LEC_ASN_SBM_ID, ASN_SBM_EVL_REG_DATE, ASN_SBM_EVL_SCORE, ASN_SBM_EVL_FEEDBACK) VALUES (SEQ_ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION_EVALUATION.NEXTVAL, #{submissionId}, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{score}, #{feedback})
